title_en: Provisions on the Limitation of Maritime Liability for Ships of Less than 300 Gross Tonnage and Ships Engaged in Coastal Transportation and Coastal Operations

articles.content_en: These Provisions are formulated in accordance with the provisions of Article 210 of the Maritime Law of the People's Republic of China.

These Provisions shall apply to vessels over 20 gross tons but less than 300 gross tons, and vessels of 300 gross tons and above engaged in cargo transportation between ports of the People's Republic of China or coastal operations.

Except as otherwise provided in Article 4 of these Provisions, the limitation of liability for maritime claims for vessels of less than 300 gross tons shall be calculated as follows:
(1) Claims for loss of life or personal injury:
a. For vessels over 20 gross tons but not exceeding 21 gross tons, the limitation amount shall be 54,000 units of account;
b. For vessels over 21 gross tons, the limitation amount shall be increased by 1,000 units of account for each additional ton over 21 gross tons.
(2) Claims other than loss of life or personal injury:
a. For vessels over 20 gross tons but not exceeding 21 gross tons, the limitation amount shall be 27,500 units of account;
b. For vessels over 21 gross tons, the limitation amount shall be increased by 500 units of account for each additional ton over 21 gross tons.

For vessels engaged in cargo transportation between ports of the People's Republic of China or coastal operations, if less than 300 gross tons, the limitation of liability for maritime claims shall be calculated as 50% of the limitation amounts provided in Article 3 of these Provisions; if 300 gross tons or more, the limitation of liability for maritime claims shall be calculated as 50% of the limitation amounts provided in Article 210, paragraph 1 of the Maritime Law of the People's Republic of China.

Where some of the vessels involved in the same incident are subject to the limitation of liability under Article 210 of the Maritime Law of the People's Republic of China or Article 3 of these Provisions, the limitation of liability for the other vessels involved shall apply the same limits.
These Provisions shall be interpreted by the Ministry of Communications of the People's Republic of China.
These Provisions shall come into force as of January 1, 1994.
